historyNotRunYet: History diagnostics have not been run yet.
bitcoinEsploraHint: Leave endpoints blank to use the built-in endpoint set for the selected network.
customRPCNote: Optional. Leave this blank to use the catalog's public endpoints. Add your own RPC URL to put a dedicated provider first for this chain's balances and sends.
etherscanNote: This chain's transaction history is read through Etherscan V2, which refuses requests without a key. Chains whose history comes from a keyless explorer do not show this field.
backendNote: Used for this chain's balances, history and sends. The first backend in the catalog is the default; switch to Custom URL to override.
backendAPIKeyNote: Optional bearer token used by your backend.
